findings.claim: The teaching says every foreign-key value must match a parent. PostgreSQL normally exempts a referencing row when any referencing column is null; the page mentions this only later in a skip-marked cheat sheet, so the core model is technically overbroad.

evidence.section: 5.5.5 Foreign Keys: null referencing columns normally need not satisfy the constraint

findings.recommendation: Qualify the core statement immediately: every non-null foreign-key value must match; add NOT NULL when the relationship is mandatory. Keep the later cheat-sheet note as reinforcement.
